{"metadata":{"description":"Runtime-switchable outbound proxy plugin for the DeepSeek Harness — hot-reload HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 routing via one settings section","id":"gh:1360388081","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-proxy","slug":"tr1v3r/dsh-proxy","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Runtime-switchable outbound proxy plugin for the DeepSeek Harness — hot-reload HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 routin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"g via one settings section"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-proxy — runtime-switchable outbound proxy for DSH"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**中文说明见 README.zh.md。**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`@tr1v3r/dsh-proxy` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes **every
in-process outbound request** —"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" LLM providers, `web_search` / `web_fetch`,
streamable-http MCP — through an HTTP(S) CONNECT or SOCK"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"S5 proxy, and lets
you **flip the proxy on, off, or to another server at runtime**, with zero
restar"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ts, either from the Web Settings → General → Network proxy control or
by editing the `dsh-proxy` ent"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ry in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (hot-reloaded).
The GIF above uses real screenshots from an i"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"solated DSH Web profile: the sidebar
proxy icon, Direct / Follow system / Manual quick switcher, and"},{"id":"p4s7","text":" Settings → General
→ Network proxy with the host-applied route snapshot. The endpoint is illustrati"},{"id":"p4s8","text":"ve;
the snapshot is not a connectivity test. For the separate terminal routing-engine
demo, run `nod"},{"id":"p4s9","text":"e scripts/demo.mjs` after install."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH and pi-ai issue requests through `globalThis.fetch`, which reads undici's
well-known global disp"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"atcher slot (`Symbol.for('undici.globalDispatcher.1')`).
The plugin owns that slot:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- `http(s)://` proxy → `EnvHttpProxyAgent` (CONNECT tunneling for https)
- `socks5://` proxy → undic"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"i's built-in `Socks5ProxyAgent` (URL credentials
supported; `socks5h://`/`socks://` normalize to it;"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" DNS resolves remotely)
- `noProxy` rules → both paths route through one `RoutingDispatcher`, so HTT"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"P
and SOCKS share identical matcher semantics (undici-style: bare entries
match the host and dot-bou"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ndary subdomains; `host:port` pins a port; `*`
bypasses everything; a leading dot or `*.` prefix is "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"accepted as a synonym
of the bare entry). In `manual` mode, ambient `NO_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` env
vars"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" are deliberately ignored by the dispatchers — exported env only steers
child processes, so in-proce"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"ss routing is fully determined by the profile
entry config. `system` mode is the opposite: it follow"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"s the ambient proxy —
`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY` env vars, falling back to
th"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"e macOS System Settings proxy (`scutil --proxy`) — re-detected each time
the section is applied, not"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" continuously polled."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"With `exportEnv: true` (default) the switch also exports
`HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`ALL_PROXY`/`NO_"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"PROXY` into the dsh process, so
child processes spawned after the switch (bash-tool `curl`/`git`, st"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"dio MCP
servers) follow the same proxy. Variables you set yourself at boot are never
clobbered, and "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"everything is restored on disable/unload. While loopback bypass is
on (the default), the exported `N"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"O_PROXY` also gains the loopback defaults
(`localhost,127.0.0.1,::1`, merged and deduplicated with y"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"our rules); with
`bypassLoopback: false` your list is exported unchanged."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Retired dispatchers close gracefully and are force-destroyed after 30 s, so
switching away actually "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tears down old keep-alive connections. In-flight
requests get that same 30-second grace period (`RET"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"IRE_DESTROY_MS`); a
streaming response that is still running ~30 s after you flip the switch is
inte"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"rrupted when the retired dispatcher's sockets are force-destroyed."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Credential security"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Proxy URLs with embedded `user:pass@` credentials are stored **in
plaintext** on disk — in the profi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"le's `cordis.patch.yml` and the settings
persistence — and are protected only by file permissions. W"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ith the default
`exportEnv: true`, the credentials are also propagated into the dsh process
as `HTTP"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"(S)_PROXY` env vars, so every child process spawned afterwards
carries them (`ps -E` on Linux/macOS "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"or `/proc/<PID>/environ` can reveal
them to the same user; other users generally need root or compar"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"able
privileges to read them, depending on platform permission settings).
No new config option is in"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"troduced for this; if
your credentials are sensitive, prefer pointing dsh-proxy at a local,
unauthen"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ticated proxy entry (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:7890` in front of an
authenticated upstream) instead of "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"embedding `user:pass@` in the URL."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"In the target profile directory (`~/.config/dsh/profiles/<name>/`):"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Add the dependency and bundle in `package.json`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"(Merge the bundle into your existing `dsh.profile.bundles` list.)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"2. Install:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"3. Restart dsh once to mount the plugin; afterwards **never again** —
switching happens through sett"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"start dsh once to mount the plugin; afterwards **never again** —
switching happens through settings."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"In the Web profile, use the icon-only **Proxy status** control in the sidebar footer
(above Settings"},{"id":"p21s2","text":") to check the selected mode on hover/focus or in its menu and switch
between Direct, Follow system,"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" and Manual proxy
without leaving the main screen. The menu uses the same settings namespace and upd"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ates
when the profile patch changes externally. The tooltip shows the manual endpoint with
credentia"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ls masked; Follow system reflects the *selected mode*, not a guarantee that
the host detected a usab"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"le proxy (consult DSH logs for the effective route). A missing
manual URL cannot be activated from t"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"he quick menu. To edit the URL, bypass hosts, or
child-process export, open Settings → General → Net"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"nu. To edit the URL, bypass hosts, or
child-process export, open Settings → General → Network proxy."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"In Settings → General → Network proxy, select Direct,
Follow system, or Manual proxy from the dropdo"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"wn; mode changes apply immediately,
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## What is covered / not covered"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Traffic | Routed? |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| LLM providers via pi-ai (`zai-coding-cn`, custom openai-compatible routes, …) | ✅ |
| `dsh-llm-dee"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"pseek` (deepseek-official) | ✅ |
| `web_search` / `web_fetch` | ✅ |
| streamable-http MCP servers | "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"✅ |
| stdio MCP servers, bash-tool subprocesses (`curl`, `git`, …) | ✅ via exported env, for process"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"es spawned after the switch |
| Loopback destinations (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `::1`, `0.0.0.0`)"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" | ❌ direct by default; set `bypassLoopback: false` to proxy them |
| pi-ai Bedrock route | ⚠️ AWS S"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"DK manages its own proxying (`HTTPS_PROXY` env is honored there) |
| Built-in browser host / browser"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" downloads | ❌ separate process, configure the browser itself |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Also note: child processes already running when you flip the switch keep the
env they were spawned w"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ith; undici's SOCKS5 agent is currently marked
experimental upstream."}],"truncated":true}
